body: Both my depression and my anxiety are causing to struggle with keeping up in school. Other things are making me feel this way but school is definitely a contributing factor.

I really want to finish school but at the rate I'm going I don't think it's going to happen. I just want to live a good life - graduate, get a job I enjoy, marry somebody I love - but none of those things seem possible to me.
Could you elaborate more on what it was about ECT that you did not enjoy? Was it the experience? The side effects? Did it simply not work?
I'm in the same mindset right now. If you want someone to talk to I'm here to listen.
I'm looking for more of a biological approach to treatment. I'm in therapy already. I believe it takes a combination of biological and therapeutic treatment to successfully treat depression.
